title: World's First Ever AI Feature Film in Cannes!
description:
Try Higgsfield: https://higgsfield.ai/s/road-to-cannes-higgsfieldai-ZYjWHJ

15 filmmakers. 14 days. One 95-minute action-fantasy feature film — made entirely in Higgsfield AI and premiered at the world's most prestigious film festival. Hell Grind didn't just show up at Cannes. It walked straight into the center of the biggest debate cinema has seen in decades.

👇 Watch the full Cannes premiere vlog in the related video
